userPrompts.text: "`@session-control /analyze`" doesn't work in cursor chat sessions. What do you recommend?
tried analyze and got: No host chat model is available for analysis. Sign in or enable a chat model, then try again.

firstResponse: I’m going to check the repo’s local guidance first, then inspect how `@session-control` routes slash commands so I can give a recommendation grounded in the extension’s current behavior.
lastResponse: `Session Control: Analyze Saved Chats` now falls back gracefully in Cursor. If Cursor returns no extension-callable chat models, the command no longer stops with the dead-end warning; it opens chat with a prefilled analysis handoff prompt that points the agent at the saved sessions, the repo AI-control guidance, and the existing analysis report/index schema. In non-Cursor hosts, the command still warns normally when no chat model is available. This follow-up only changed the Cursor fallback path and its tests. The next time you run Analyze in Cursor, you should get a prefilled chat prompt instead of the “No host chat model is available” warning.
